name: The Shire
description: A peaceful land west of Bree, guarded by distance and secrecy.
bonus50: Once per battle: ignore the first failed Courage test.
bonus100: Once per battle: after deployment, redeploy one friendly warband/unit.

name: Bree-land
description: A rare meeting place of peoples and news in Eriador.
bonus50: +1 to a single priority roll per battle.
bonus100: Once per battle: after losing priority, you may re-roll it.

name: Rohan
description: Great plains of horse-lords between the Isen and Anduin.
bonus50: One model/unit may gain +1" Move for the battle.
bonus100: Once per battle: one mounted unit/model may re-roll a charge.

name: Gondor
description: Strongholds of the West, holding the line against Mordor.
bonus50: Once per battle: re-roll one Injury roll.
bonus100: Once per battle: after scoring, gain +1 VP (or equivalent) if you control an objective.

name: Mordor
description: Ash plains and fortresses under the Shadow of Barad-dûr.
bonus50: Once per battle: one unit/model gains +1 to Wound for a single fight/shooting sequence.
bonus100: Once per battle: after an enemy uses a special rule/stratagem, force them to re-roll it if possible.
